name_zh: 一步转移理论与405对长程挑战实验合同
scientific_objective: Predict the adjacent functional state from the established prestate and the current realized training action on unseen runs, then use the frozen theory in an online recursive long-horizon stress test.

challenge_set.name_zh: 跨运行长程近邻初态—异未来挑战集
challenge_set.name_en: Cross-run Long-horizon Near-state Divergent-future Challenge Set
challenge_set.allowed_use: online recursive long-horizon stress test after the one-step theory is frozen and passes unseen-run evaluation
challenge_set.forbidden_claim: The 405 pairs directly prove one-step state insufficiency or constitute one-step counterexamples.

event_order: form current gradient, Adam deltas and actual parameter update
execute target CSRG probe and establish X_t_plus_1

one_step_dataset.sample_unit: one legal adjacent transition (X_t, U_t, X_t_plus_1)
required_identity_fields: X_t object, version, fact-node and probe-occurrence identities
U_t batch, gradient, clipped-gradient, Adam-delta and actual-update identities
X_t_plus_1 object, version, fact-node and target-probe occurrence identities
one_step_dataset.missing_policy: NOT_EVALUABLE or LEAKAGE_INVALID; never impute or silently drop

one_step_counterexamples.primary_kind: baseline one-step prediction error instances on an outer held-out run
primary_error_conditions: continuous functional state fails the development-frozen ONE_STEP_STATE_ACCEPTABLE rule
one_step_counterexamples.auxiliary_kind: cross-run transition-conflict pairs near in both X_t and U_t but separated in true X_t_plus_1 under development-frozen scales
one_step_counterexamples.threshold_source: development runs only before held-out targets are read

baselines: B_prior_M0 refit inside each outer development set
candidate_state_layers: M_local only when legally formed before the target boundary and reproducible online

outer_evaluation.inner_selection: leave-one-run-out within the twelve development runs

long_horizon_stress_test.success: correct true h100 ordering and at least 0.10 predicted separation

mechanism_evidence_not_resolution: endpoint fitting after reading a complete future path
evidence_hard_gates: fact, identity, version and hash validation
